answer: Sybil keys are free, so charge for vantage instead. Each seat must, every epoch, post a signed receipt from a distinct network vantage: a unique ASN plus a hardware-attested device serial, deduplicated on-ledger so an entire cloud region collapses into one seat. Extra seats then cost a separate provider contract, a real IP block and a bonded attestation that no script mints for free. A farm can stage a crowded dune of keys yet sits at the nadir of real network reach, while honest agents spread like lotus across many independent operators.
